title: CROA Grounded Governed Action (gga.*)
description: The C3-validated derivative of a governed action request, forwarded to C2 and stored as cc.action. Normative source: CROA Standard Part II §4.5.1. In any discrepancy, Part II §4.5.1 prevails.

gga.request_id.description: The gar.request_id of the originating governed action request.

gga.resolved_entities.description: Entities from gar.context_refs resolved against the technical golden record.

canonical_id.description: Canonical identifier of the resolved entity.

state.description: Current state of the entity at resolution time.

gga.semantic_result.description: GROUNDED = all references resolved; CONTEXT_FAILURE = one or more unresolvable.

gga.unresolved_refs.description: Subset of gar.context_refs that could not be resolved. MUST be empty iff GROUNDED.

gga.delegation.description: OPTIONAL. Present only for a delegated action in governed multi-agent delegation (Appendix L). Absent for a non-delegated action; where present, all listed sub-fields are required (Appendix L §L.4, D2–D4).

authorizing_subject.description: Subject identity that delegated authority for this action (the orchestrator).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC token expiry; a token presented after this fails-deny (D4).

max_depth.description: Maximum delegation depth permitted on this chain (D4).

depth.description: This hop's depth in the chain; MUST NOT exceed max_depth.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session linkage so C4 treats the orchestrated work as one trajectory unit (D4, TH-7).

signature.description: Authorizing subject's signature over the delegation token.

delegationScope.description: Canonical Appendix L delegated-scope profile. A presented scope is valid only if the OCP can canonicalize and prove it is a subset of the authorizing subject's current scope; otherwise the delegated action fails-deny.

subject_id.description: Subject identity to whom this delegated scope applies.

action_classes.description: Canonical governed action classes permitted by this delegated scope. The OCP sorts and deduplicates this set before subset comparison.

targets.description: Canonical target identifiers resolved against the Technical Golden Record (C3). Aliases or local names that cannot be resolved fail-deny.

parameter_constraints.description: Parameter predicate for the delegated scope. The predicate MUST be expressed in the deterministic constraint profile declared by C1; if implication cannot be proven, subset comparison fails.

profile.description: C1-declared deterministic constraint profile used to interpret expression.

expression.description: Constraint expression in the declared profile. The expression must logically imply the authorizing subject's predicate for scope narrowing to be established.

validity_window.description: Validity interval for the delegated scope; it must be wholly contained in the authorizing subject's active scope window.

invariant_context.description: Policy and invariant context against which this scope was issued. A stale, widened, or incomparable context fails-deny.

$comment: A gga with gga.semantic_result = CONTEXT_FAILURE MUST NOT be forwarded to C2. cc.action carries a gga.* with gga.semantic_result = GROUNDED.
